subject: Procurement & PO process — next steps (AcmeCloud)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmecloud.com>, Jenna Liu <jenna.liu@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement & PO process — next steps (AcmeCloud)

Hi Samir / Jenna,

Thanks again for the call today — great to hear more about AcmeCloud's use cases and the timeline for a pilot. Per our discussion, I wanted to recap the agreed next steps and the procurement path options so your team can map internal owners.

Key items we covered:
- Legal review: share SOW + contract template for your legal team to review.
- Security review: we will provide SOC 2 summary, data flow diagram, and our security questionnaire (if you want the full packet).
- Finance / procurement: clarify purchasing path (PO vs. corporate card) and expected PO issuance timeline. You mentioned PO is standard for >$50k.
- Marketplace interest: you asked about AWS Marketplace — we can provide a SKU and marketplace quoting if you'd prefer that route.

Attaching a draft mutual action plan (MPA) to capture owners, milestones, and expected dates. Also attaching the SOW draft for legal review. Can you please: 
1) Confirm owners for Legal, Security, and Finance (name + email)
2) Confirm whether AcmeCloud will require a PO or if a card is acceptable for the pilot value (est. $18k)
3) Flag any additional evidence you need from security (SOC 2 report, penetration test summary, etc.)

Planned timeline (proposal from our side):
- Redwood sends SOW + MPA: today (attached)
- AcmeCloud legal review: target 1-2 weeks -> expected by 2026-07-20
- Security questionnaire & review: target 1 week after legal -> expected by 2026-07-24
- Finance PO issuance (if PO path): target by 2026-08-05

If marketplace is preferred, we can run parallel work to get pricing/SKU ready — that path sometimes shortens procurement cycles for finance.

Attachments:
- Redwood-MPA-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan)
- SOW-draft.pdf

Next call suggestion: 30-min MPA check-in the week of 2026-07-20 to confirm legal/security progress — are you available Wed 7/21 or Thu 7/22?

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
(650) 555-0124

[Attachment: Redwood-MPA-v1.xlsx]
[Attachment: SOW-draft.pdf]

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmecloud.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenna Liu <jenna.liu@acmecloud.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement & PO process — next steps (AcmeCloud)

Laura,

Appreciate the summary — that matches our notes. Quick answers from my side:
- Owners: Legal -> Jenna Liu (jenna.liu@acmecloud.com), Security -> myself (I'll loop in our security lead once we have the questionnaire), Finance -> Mark Donovan (mark.donovan@acmecloud.com).
- PO vs card: For pilot sizes under $25k a card is acceptable, but we generally require a PO for anything that will be on a multi-month commitment or exceeds $50k. For the pilot estimate (~$18k), card is fine. If we expand, we'll need a PO.
- Security asks: SOC 2 report and a data flow diagram would be helpful. Pen test summary would be nice but not required at this stage.

One additional note: finance may prefer AWS Marketplace if pricing and invoicing match our purchase order needs — can you confirm whether Redwood supports both direct PO and marketplace invoicing?

I'll review the MPA and share with Jenna/Mark today.

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Platform Engineering, AcmeCloud
samir.patel@acmecloud.com

Hi Samir / Jenna,

Thanks for the quick replies and for confirming owners. I pulled together a concise mutual action plan below (also in the attached MPA spreadsheet) with owners and target dates so your team can drop these into your trackers. If anything is off, flag it and we'll update.

Mutual Action Plan (high-level)
- 2026-07-12 (today): Redwood shares final SOW draft + MPA (attached) — Owner: Redwood (Laura)

Marketplace path (parallel):
- If AcmeCloud prefers AWS Marketplace invoicing, Redwood can provide a SKU and marketplace quote within 3 business days. Marketplace invoicing can simplify procurement but sometimes requires additional vendor setup in finance (we've seen it speed invoicing for some finance teams).

What Redwood will provide this week:
- SOW-draft.pdf (attached)
- Redwood-MPA-v1.xlsx (attached)
- SOC 2 summary & data flow diagram (Marcus will send the packet by 7/14)

Can you confirm Jenna will target legal redlines by 7/20 and Mark can aim for PO/approval by 8/5 (if PO path)? Once you confirm I'll schedule a 30-min MPA check-in for Wed 7/21 11:00am PT — otherwise propose Thu 7/22 10:00am PT.
